name: Georg Avalon
original_name: ゲオルグ・アヴァロン
source:
Margot's father. Husband of the former empress Ursula. Since he is from the commoner class, he does not have the right to succeed to the throne himself, but until Margot comes of age and ascends to the throne, he manages the affairs of Euro as the Archduke Regent of Avalon. His marriage to Ursula was big news at the time, but it seems that some nobles still look down on him as a commoner.

His wife died 12 years ago, and around the same time he had the misfortune of being forced to relinquish his daughter to a distant land to protect him from assassins. Since then, he has never seen Margot again.

[Translated from [url=http://sugar.f-sp.net/]official website[/url]]
